rationale: Price is at 100% of today's range after a 14.7% gap-up on strong earnings, with the last candle showing a surge to the session high on elevated volume — but this is an extended, late-stage move with the stock already up ~23% from yesterday's close and sitting at the very top of its intraday range. Chasing a long here risks buying exhaustion at the high, while shorting into a strong fundamental catalyst with 5.4x relative volume and upward momentum carries equal risk of continuation. The risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable given the extreme extension and tight spread between last price and today's high.
